notes: Adds core logic, facade integration, API exposure, and limitations handling for explainability.

stories.title: Implement Explainability Mapping Logic
stories.description: Build backend logic to map raw evaluation signals from provider and clinical trial services into the standardized explainability schema, including population of source, meaning, and limitations fields.

stories.title: Integrate Explainability into EvaluateCareFacade
stories.description: Extend EvaluateCareFacade to attach explainability metadata to all outbound evaluation responses for providers and clinical trials, ensuring consistent orchestration across signals.

stories.title: Expose Explainability in API Responses
stories.description: Update API response contracts and tool outputs to include explainability fields, ensuring compatibility with tool_router and downstream chat rendering.

stories.title: Standardize Limitations and Disclaimers
stories.description: Define and implement consistent limitations/disclaimer text for each evaluation signal type (e.g., NPI data freshness, external link reliability, trial eligibility variability) within the explainability layer.
